how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application proforma printed at the end of the notification. It covers name, position applied for, father's/husband name, date of birth and age, gender, address, mobile number, Aadhar number, email ID, educational qualifications, additional qualifications, experience and any other details.
Paste your photograph in the space on the form.
Sign the declaration that the information is true and correct.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents. The application must be complete in all respects.

content_sections.heading: About LUVAS
content_sections.text: Lala Lajpat Rai University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences (LUVAS) is a university in Hisar, Haryana (PIN 125004). This recruitment is for the Department of Livestock Production Management in its College of Veterinary Sciences. The posts serve the department's project "Field Progeny Testing programme for Buffalo Improvement (Murrah)". The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Dipin Chander Yadav.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need one of these essential qualifications for the Field Artificial Insemination (A.I) worker-cum-data recorder post: MAITRI (Multipurpose Artificial Insemination Technicians in Rural India) certificate from an Artificial Insemination Training Institute (AITI) accredited by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Govt. of India; OR Veterinary and Livestock Development Diploma from a recognised University/Institute; OR Artificial Insemination training certificate from a Govt. Institute like Haryana Veterinary Training Institute (HVTI), Hisar. Desirable: Skilled in A.I. and Pregnancy diagnosis, Semen handling, record keeping. Age limit: The minimum age is 18 years and the upper age limit is 50 years. Age is counted as on the last date of application (5 November 2026). Preference: Preference goes to candidates from the selected village(s) under the project or from nearby. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for the post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- + HRA (As per LUVAS rules). The engaged person will be entitled to TA/DA as per rules. Salary will be paid when the funds are received from the funding agency. The engagement is co-terminus with the project. When the project ends, the person will be relieved. The university or department will not be responsible for adjusting him/her in the university. The engaged person will not be a regular employee of the university. He/she will not get CPF/GPF or any other benefit admissible to regular employees. The services can be terminated at any time if work and conduct are not found satisfactory, after giving due opportunity of being heard. They can also be terminated at any time because of a shortage of funds. A selected candidate who wants to leave can do so after giving 15 days' notice in writing to the department/university.

content_sections.heading: LUVAS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Artificial Insemination in Murrah buffaloes of selected villages, Record keeping, Pregnancy diagnosis, milk recording, reports preparation, semen handling, awareness to farmers and all other project related activities. Any other work assigned by the PI or the university authorities. The project will run in selected villages of Hisar district on the Hisar-balsamand and/or Hisar-Chaudhariwas routes. The place of work will be the selected village(s) and the Department of Livestock Production Management, COVS, LUVAS. The Principal Investigator may also depute the person to any other place.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LUVAS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed application proforma printed at the end of the notification. It covers name, position applied for, father's/husband name, date of birth and age, gender, address, mobile number, Aadhar number, email ID, educational qualifications, additional qualifications, experience and any other details. Paste your photograph in the space on the form. Sign the declaration that the information is true and correct. Attach self-attested copies of the documents. The application must be complete in all respects. Send it by post or by hand to: The Professor and Head, Department of Livestock Production Management, College of Veterinary Sciences, LUVAS, Hisar -125004 (Haryana). You can also email it to [email protected] . Make sure it arrives by 5 November 2026, up to 5:00 P.M. Applications that arrive later will not be accepted for any reason. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LUVAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 positions of Field Artificial Insemination (A.I) worker-cum-data recorder, in the General category. Both are under the Murrah buffalo field progeny testing project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the LUVAS Field A.I worker-cum-data recorder post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the department by 5 November 2026, up to 5:00 P.M. Applications that arrive after that will not be accepted for any reason.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the LUVAS Field A.I worker-cum-data recorder post?
faq.answer: You need one of three: a MAITRI certificate from a DAHD-accredited AITI, a Veterinary and Livestock Development Diploma from a recognised University/Institute, or an A.I training certificate from a Govt. Institute like HVTI, Hisar. Skill in A.I., pregnancy diagnosis, semen handling and record keeping is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LUVAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the upper age limit is 50 years. Age is counted as on the last date of application, 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a LUVAS Field A.I worker-cum-data recorder?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- + HRA (As per LUVAS rules). Salary is paid when the funds are received from the funding agency.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the Rs. 20,000/- pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid as per LUVAS rules, and the engaged person is entitled to TA/DA as per rules. CPF/GPF and other benefits for regular employees are not given.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for LUVAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach self-attested copies of your documents. Send it by post or by hand to The Professor and Head, Department of Livestock Production Management, College of Veterinary Sciences, LUVAS, Hisar -125004 (Haryana), or email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is the LUVAS Field A.I worker-cum-data recorder job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely contractual and lasts only as long as the project. The engaged person is not a regular employee of the university.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the LUVAS Field A.I worker-cum-data recorder work?
faq.answer: The work will be mainly in selected villages of Hisar district on the Hisar-balsamand and/or Hisar-Chaudhariwas routes, and in the Department of Livestock Production Management, LUVAS. The Principal Investigator can also depute the person to any other place. Candidates from the selected villages or nearby get preference.
